title: Pest Expert Clothes Moth Killer Smoke Bombs 8 x 3.5g - Formula 'P' Maximum Strength Moth Bomb, Fast-Acting for Effective Control, Professional Strength for Approved Amateur Use
bullet_points: ✅ THE STRONGEST CLOTHES MOTH SMOKE BOMB ON THE MARKET - Containing maximum strength Permethrin, this powerful fumigation device provides rapid knockdown of clothes moths.
✅ FAST ACTING – Once ignited, this fast-acting smoke bomb kills clothes moths on contact.
✅ TOTAL INDOOR FUMIGATION SOLUTION – This smoke bomb will fully fumigate even the largest rooms, reaching all the areas you wouldn’t able to with any other products.
✅ INTEGRAL FOR A COMPREHENSIVE TREATMENT – Formula P Smoke Bombs are integral to any comprehensive moth treatment, killing moths in the airspace.
✅ NON-STAINING AND LOW-ODOUR – After ventilation there will be no nasty residues or smells on any household furnishing, making it the perfect treatment in any home or business.
description: Pest Expert Formula 'P' Fumer insecticidal smoke bombs are a fast and effective Clothes Moth killer. Fumers are an integral part of any moth treatment as it helps to penetrate cracks and crevices where moth larvae and eggs are harbouring. The fumers contain the powerful insecticide Permethrin, like the Formula P powder, however it is a lot more concentrated meaning its faster acting and goes considerably further than the powder. To maintain successful Clothes Moth control use in conjunction with Pest Expert Formula 'C' Clothes Moth Spray. One fumer will treat an average size room of approx 4m x 3m. To treat more widespread infestations, add extra fumers as necessary. Contain Permethrin at 13.25% w/w. Contains Potassium Chlorate 12.5-15%.
